Pico.js and the Facefinder cascade are bundled for local face detection.
Source: https://github.com/ringcentral/picojs
Original implementation: Nenad Markuš, https://github.com/nenadmarkus/picojs
The source declares the MIT license. The source license notice is preserved in pico.js.
Model path: facefinder.bin. No external photo recognition service is used.
